name: Create project from fileexplorer
description:
1. **Goal:** added a "New codx-junior project" entry to the file-explorer context menu (`filebrowser/ContextMenu.vue` + `FileExplorer.vue`) that registers the right-clicked folder as a project.
2. **Reuse over reinvention:** the ad-hoc `filebrowser/ConfirmDialog.vue` was deleted in favour of the existing `@/components/ConfirmDialog.vue` (`confirmRequest` / `confirmAction()`), and the action now opens the shared `NewProject.vue` dialog via `$ui.showNewProject({ path })` instead of posting to the API behind a native `confirm()`.
3. **Store bug fixed:** `store/project.js → createNewProject` was destructuring only `{ project_name, git_path }` and silently dropping the incoming `project_path`; it now uses `git_path || project_path || project_name`.
4. **Runtime bugs found and fixed:** `newProject` is now passed as a **prop** to the dialog (reading `this.$storex.ui` inside `data()` throws, because mixin computeds are undefined at that stage), and `App.vue` no longer passes the static string attribute `close="true"` (PropType `Boolean`) and now listens for the dialog's `close` event.
5. **Outcome:** the folder path arrives prefilled in the New project dialog (name + location), the dialog opens/closes correctly, and projects are created at the selected folder — but the earlier `generate_code` on `FileExplorer.vue`/`NewProject.vue` was never confirmed complete, so end-to-end verification in the browser is still pending.


Reuse the existing dialog components; never create a local modal copy.

- `src/components/Modal.vue` is registered globally in `src/main.ts` → usable as `<modal close @close>` in any template. Props: `title`, `fullscreen`, `scope`, `close`. Slots: default (body), `header`, `footer`. It teleports itself to the app root, handles ESC and the backdrop.
- `src/components/ConfirmDialog.vue` is the project-wide confirmation (built on `<modal>`): props `title`, `message`, `details[]`, `hint`, `icon`, `iconClass`, `confirmLabel`, `confirmIcon`, `confirmClass`, `busy`; events `confirm` / `cancel`. Focus starts on Cancel (safe choice).

Call sites: `if (!(await this.confirmAction({...}))) return`.
- Never use native `confirm()`, `alert()` or `prompt()`: they are light-only, block the page, have no focus management and cannot show context (paths, items).
- Destructive actions: `confirmClass: 'btn-error'` + `icon: 'fa-trash'`, `iconClass: 'text-error'`.
- Before writing any dialog, search `src/components/**` for an existing one (`*Modal.vue`, `*Dialog.vue`) — many feature-specific ones already exist.
